acceptanceCriteria: Successful write returns path, bytes/lines, hash, and does not return file content by default.
Successful edit returns path, number of replacements, and only an optional tiny bounded summary.
Successful bash returns command, exit code, duration, and bounded last-N-lines output by default.
Failed commands return exit code plus bounded stderr/stdout excerpts sufficient for diagnosis.
Standard compact result shape includes status, summary, paths, counts, truncated, artifactPath, and nextAction where applicable.
Unit tests cover result-size caps and failure excerpts; golden/snapshot tests cover compact success outputs.
planning.tddSlice: tool_result hook compacts built-in read/write/edit/bash results into a standard envelope without changing tool execution
